# THTH

> THTH is a command-line tool for researching, posting to, scheduling on and
> managing your own social media accounts (Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, X).
> Because it is a CLI, an LLM can drive it; the bundled MCP server and skills
> only make that easier. Everything it does is recorded in your git. Nothing
> leaves your machine unless you opt in.

## Where to start (the same three lines `thth --help` opens with)

- Post one draft, once → `thth send <account> --text-file <file>` (a rehearsal
  by default; nothing goes out until you add `--production` with the digest the
  rehearsal printed). `thth collect` picks these up too, even with no repo —
  the ledgers then live under `$THTH_ROOT/state/<account>/data/sns/`.
- Run an account from a queue → `thth lint <file>` → `thth approve <file>` (two
  steps) → `thth throw <account>`
- Ask before you post → `thth ask before-you-post <account> --topic <word>`

Looking for a post to reply to: `thth topics <account> --search <word> [--json]` lists each hit's `post_id`, permalink, per-post replies (`—` means unknown, never zero) and a mark where your own queue already holds a `reply_to` draft — read-only, bodies shown but never stored, and the topic shelf is not written to.

## Three things an agent should know before calling it

- `thth ask before-you-post <account> --topic <word> [--kind …] [--hour-band …]
  [--reply] [--json]` — read-only, answers from **the caller's own local
  ledgers**, never the network. The draft body is not an input and never
  appears in the output. Returns seven keys (`summary`, `expected`,
  `comparable`, `cannot_say`, `one_thing_to_change`, `audience`,
  `provenance`); **most answers are `cannot_say`** until an account has at
  least `--min-n` (default 20) comparable posts inside `--window-days`
  (default 30). `cannot_say` is a correct answer, not an error — exit 0. Same
  tool over MCP as `before_you_post`.
- The read-only lookups (`thth where`, `thth thread`, `thth who`) save
  nothing; all that persists is the engagement ledger (your own acts and
  reactions).
- Operator only: `thth account add <name> --media threads|bluesky|mastodon|x --project <p> --by masaru` —
  writes one ledger from the bundled template to `$THTH_ROOT/accounts/`,
  **outside the repo**, always `production: false`. `thth account migrate`
  copies ledgers out of an older in-repo `accounts/` directory (copy, not
  move; never overwrites).

## Docs

- [README.en.md](README.en.md): what it guarantees, refuses, and never does; install; where ledgers live; daily flow; every real CLI command
- [docs/usage.en.md](docs/usage.en.md): day-to-day usage — topics, queueing, two-step approval, troubleshooting, account ledgers (§9), `thth ask` (§10), reading before you reply — `thth where` / `thth thread` / `thth who` and `thth after` (§11)
- [docs/導入_承認を押すだけ.md](docs/導入_承認を押すだけ.md) (Japanese): invited users approve a URL; Masaru manages the server, clients and ledgers. Threads/Mastodon/X use `auth --by`; X is auth-only. Bluesky App Password enters through `token set --stdin --by`. No connection page yet. Never put credentials or authorization URLs into LLM context.
- [thth.me](https://thth.me): project home
